identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a vehicle interface that feels like a piece of high-performance hardware, not a website.
principles: Fusion: 1989 Retro-Futurism x 2025 Type R Precision
Latency is Death: 60fps animations or nothing
Data Hierarchy: RPM is King, everything else is secondary
Night Vision: Total darkness mastery (OLED blacks)

usage.headings: Chivo (Bold/Black) - For static labels (RPM, SPEED, OIL)

structure.warning_strip: col-span-full h-16 (Top or Bottom fixed bar)

tachometer.specs: Must be responsive. Use SVG arcs. Smooth transition on value change.
tachometer.animation: Spring physics (stiff: 120, damping: 14) for needle movement

data_card.classes: bg-card/50 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl shadow-inner

buttons.classes: h-12 px-8 uppercase tracking-widest font-bold border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5 active:scale-95 transition-all

images.name: carbon_fiber_dark
images.usage: Background overlay for Sport Mode with low opacity (10-20%)

images.name: honda_logo_white
images.usage: Boot sequence and steering wheel center (Use this URL as fallback or search for SVG)

transitions.value_update: Number counter effect for digital readouts

universal_guidelines: NEVER use white backgrounds. This is a car dashboard.
Contrast is safety. Text must be readable at 70mph.
Touch targets must be large (min 48px) for clumsy fingers.
Avoid complex gradients. Use flat colors or subtle radial glows.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install 'lucide-react' and 'recharts'. 2. Create a 'Gauge' component using SVG. 3. Implement the 'ThemeContext' to handle switching between Type R (Red) and Retro (Amber). 4. Build the 'BootSequence' component as the entry point. 5. Use the provided carbon fiber image as a subtle background texture in CSS.
